lead.tldr: Spot Bitcoin ETFs hit five-week outflow total of $3.8B signaling institutional de-risking amid macro uncertainty. • Bitcoin whales accumulate 236K BTC in 90 days countering ETF selling for potential bullish reversal. • Nakamoto completes $107M all-stock acquisition of BTC Inc. consolidating key industry players. • Aave DAO faces governance crisis as BGD Labs exits in April pressuring token price. • Superstate raises $82.5M to expand onchain equity issuance beyond tokenized Treasuries. • Trump 10% global tariff raises trade war risks impacting crypto investor risk appetite.

top_signals.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs Post Five Consecutive Weeks of Outflows Reaching $3.8B
top_signals.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $315.9 million in outflows last week, marking the fifth consecutive week of net withdrawals totaling $3.8 billion, driven by institutional de-risking amid geopolitical tensions and macroeconomic uncertainty. This trend reflects short-term portfolio adjustments by hedge funds and leveraged investors rather than a complete exit from the asset, as evidenced by sustained redemptions from leaders like BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC. Despite the outflows, cumulative inflows since the January 2024 launch remain robust at over $54 billion, underscoring enduring long-term institutional demand for Bitcoin exposure. Ether ETFs have mirrored this pressure with their own negative flows, highlighting a broader caution in crypto allocations.

top_signals.title: Done Deal: Nakamoto Closes $107M All-Stock Takeover of CEO David Bailey's BTC Inc. & UTXO
top_signals.summary: Nakamoto has completed its $107 million all-stock acquisition of BTC Inc. and UTXO, which was announced earlier this week. The deal involves CEO David Bailey's company.

top_signals.title: Prediction markets are bending insider trading rules. But will they break them?
top_signals.summary: The article discusses the increasing concerns around insider trading in prediction markets, highlighting the blurred lines between having an edge and breaking the law. It mentions that bills are being drafted to address loopholes in the current regulations.

top_signals.title: Aave struggles as BGD Labs plans April exit amid governance crisis
top_signals.summary: Aave token is facing pressure as BGD Labs plans to exit in April amid an escalating governance crisis. This development introduces uncertainty and potential instability within the Aave ecosystem.

top_signals.title: Big Wins for Two of Venture's Most Envied Firms: $10 Billion for Thrive & an Altman for Benchmark
top_signals.summary: Thrive reportedly raised $10 billion, and Benchmark added Altman to their team. The article also mentions regulators battling over prediction markets.

top_signals.title: Superstate Raises $82.5M to Scale Onchain Equity Issuance
top_signals.summary: Superstate raised $82.5M in a Series B round led by Bain Capital Crypto. The funding will be used to expand their services from tokenized Treasuries to SEC-registered equity issuance onchain.

top_signals.title: Uniswap Founder Slams Scam Crypto Ads After Victim 'Lost Everything'
top_signals.summary: Uniswap founder Hayden Adams is warning users about persistent scam ads impersonating Uniswap. These ads have reportedly caused users to lose funds.

top_signals.title: Vitalik Buterin is building a 'cypherpunk principled non-ugly Ethereum' as devs officially add FOCIL to upgrade roadmap
top_signals.summary: Vitalik Buterin is working on a 'cypherpunk principled non-ugly Ethereum'. FOCIL has been officially scheduled for inclusion as the consensus-layer headliner for the Hegota upgrade, targeted for late 2026.

top_signals.title: BNP Paribas taps Ethereum for new money market fund tokenization pilot
top_signals.summary: BNP Paribas is piloting a new money market fund tokenization project using its AssetFoundryTM platform on Ethereum. The tokenized shares were issued using a permissioned access model.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Whales Rebuild Reserves With 236K BTC in 90-days
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin whales have rebuilt their reserves to levels seen before October 2025, accumulating 236K BTC in 90 days. This accumulation occurs even as crypto exchange flows reach multi-month highs, suggesting a potentially bullish outlook.

top_signals.title: Aave price tumbles as ‘most productive’ contractor leaves DAO
top_signals.summary: Bored Ghosts Developing, a key contractor for the Aave DAO, will not renew its contract due to disagreements with Aave Labs' proposals. This departure is considered a significant loss for the Aave DAO.

top_signals.title: Trump imposes 10% global tariff in bid to salvage trade plans
top_signals.summary: Donald Trump is imposing a 10% global tariff and plans to keep existing import taxes. He also signaled plans to launch more trade investigations.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, The crypto landscape is shifting fast, blending short-term volatility with bold structural moves that signal enduring momentum. Spot Bitcoin ETFs just posted $315.9 million in outflows last week, capping five straight weeks of net withdrawals totaling $3.8 billion. Hedge funds and leveraged players are de-risking amid geopolitical tensions and macro uncertainty, with heavy redemptions from BlackRock's IBIT and Fidelity's FBTC. Yet this looks like tactical portfolio tweaks, not a retreat. Cumulative inflows since January 2024 still top $54 billion, proving rock-solid long-term institutional hunger for Bitcoin. Ether ETFs are feeling similar caution, pointing to broader wariness in crypto bets right now. Meanwhile, a massive deal underscores consolidation in the space. Nakamoto has sealed its $107 million all-stock takeover of BTC Inc. and UTXO, the firms led by CEO David Bailey. This move highlights how industry leaders are merging strengths to build scale in a maturing market. On another front, prediction markets are testing the boundaries of insider trading rules. With blurred lines between savvy edges and outright illegality, regulators are drafting bills to plug loopholes and clarify the playbook. At Blockwall, Europe's dedicated crypto VC, we stay laser-focused on backing pre-seed and seed founders tackling real-world Web3 challenges. From tokenized money markets like our portfolio company Spiko to IoT innovations like Staex, we empower the builders driving this evolution.
